samples.question: A 3x3 grid hides one solid triangle split into nine fragments. Every cell has been rotated about its own center by a multiple of 90 degrees, and a small colored key dot near one corner marks where that cell's bottom-left corner now points. Undo the declared per-cell quarter-turns by rotating each cell so its key dot sits at the bottom-left, then read the reassembled triangle. Does it point up (A) or down (B)? Answer A or B.
